title: Bedsure Orthopedic Dog Bed for Medium Dogs - Waterproof Dog Sofa Beds Medium, Supportive Foam Pet Couch Bed with Removable Washable Cover, Waterproof Lining and Nonskid Bottom, Grey
features: Orthopedic Support: Our orthopedic cat sofa is designed to give your pet unparalleled support for a deep, dreamy sleep. High-density egg crate foam helps distribute weight evenly and provides the perfect amount of pressure relief and joint support.

Improved comfort: The reinforced 4-sided design promotes maximum comfort and safety, offering your pet a variety of cozy positions to snuggle up with. The padded shape is deeply filled to support your pet's head and neck for a more restful sleep. And the lowered entry protects your pet's knees and promotes accessibility.
Waterproof and easy care: The case features a laminated waterproof layer that helps protect against spills and accidents. Simply open and remove the case for quick machine wash and easy care.
Tested and pet approved: This pet support bed is wrapped in our soft velvety flannel fabric, providing soothing comfort that your furry friend will find cozy and relaxing.

Pet safe materials: This OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Certified Pet Bed (24.HCN.46956) consists of CertiPUR-US certified foam and luxurious flannel, creating a safe and comfortable space for your furry friend to rest and recharge. Non-slip bottom reduces slippage and protects your dog.
